snippet.title: A Short Quest | King's Wood Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
A Short Quest is a modern take on classic first-person RPGs, heavily inspired by adventures like King’s Field, Gothic, and early Elder Scrolls titles. In this hand-crafted world creativity is rewarded through challenging combat, immersive environments and secrets to solve.

Join the new King's Wood Playtest and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4351810/A_Short_Quest/?v3=true

Join the Discord: https://youtu.be/nkYyrLVl3qY
